title: Firefox Enterprise
excerpt: Firefox Enterprise puts customer privacy, independence and control first.
content_html:
‍
It takes a different kind of tech company to build a different kind of enterprise browser.

Firefox Enterprise puts customer privacy, independence and control first.

Modern work lives in the browser. So does modern enterprise risk.

The browser is where work, data, identity, and AI converge. That makes it a critical layer for governance and compliance — and one many enterprise technology stacks still don’t fully cover.

Firefox Enterprise brings browser management to your own infrastructure.

Sovereignty

Bring deployment and data under your control.

Deploy Firefox Enterprise on-premises, within your own infrastructure. Define and audit where your data, policies and management live.

Control

Protect data and access in the browser.

Prevent sensitive data from leaving the browser and give employees, contractors and BYOD users secure, identity-based access to internal applications — without the infrastructure of traditional remote access.

Resilience

Strengthen browser autonomy.

Built on Mozilla’s independent engine, Firefox Enterprise adds browser diversity that reduces shared failure risk and vendor lock-in – while integrating seamlessly with your current security stack.

Built to help organizations meet demanding regulatory requirements.

DORA GDPR NIS2 ISO27001 SOC2

See what upleveling to Firefox Enterprise can bring to your business.

Firefox Enterprise

On-prem browser governance for regulated and security-sensitive organizations

  • Centralized policy control — manage browser behavior across endpoints
  • External connection controls — govern browser callouts and telemetry
  • Native DLP — warn or block sensitive data actions by domain
  • AI controls — allow, restrict or disable AI tools
  • SIEM integration — export browser events and audit activity
  • Lockdown Mode — harden high-risk or restricted browsing
  • Extension governance — allow or block add-ons organization-wide
  • Professional Support included — private triage and defined response times

Firefox

The browser everyone loves can be used at your organization, too.

  • Private and secure — built-in protections for everyday browsing
  • Regular updates — frequent improvements and feature releases
  • Professional Support available — direct access to Mozilla experts

Coming Soon

Thunderbird Enterprise

Centralized management of Thunderbird email, calendar and contacts, right from the Firefox Enterprise console.

Your business now has backup. Introducing Firefox Professional Support.

Give your IT staff a direct path to the people behind the product, helping them resolve issues quicker and with less guesswork.

Firefox Enterprise. Different at the core. Stronger because of it.

Only a different business model, driven by different incentives, can deliver a fundamentally different kind of enterprise solution. One that gives organizations more.

More Control

Your management console runs on your infrastructure.

More Transparency

The browser is open source. You can see how it handles your data.

More Choice

Integrates with your tooling. No ecosystem lock-in.

More Resilience

Built on Mozilla's own browser engine.
